import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [

        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_49/test_13.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_49/test_14.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, usecols=['emp_title'])
        # Ensure emp_title is integer type as per target schema
        df['emp_title'] = df['emp_title'].astype(int)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union all)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is ['emp_title'] integer, so no further transformation needed
    # Just save the combined DataFrame to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_49/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
